control_flow: The start block runs: forever call followInTheDark.
followInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 (dim light): if the line light < 40 (black) curve left; else if the line light > 88 (white) curve right; otherwise nothing. In bright light: nothing.
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called, so their blocks never run.
avoidWalls would: in dim light turn right 20° if an obstacle is LEFT, turn left 20° if RIGHT, else call driveInTheDark; in bright light call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark would: in dim light drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall would: if an obstacle is FRONT stop, else call followLine.
followLine would: on black curve left (10 %, 40 %), else curve right (40 %, 10 %).
